def list_sets(family='ipv4'):
    """
    .. versionadded:: 2014.7.0

    List all ipset sets.

    CLI Example:

    .. code-block:: bash

        salt '*' ipset.list_sets

    """
    cmd = "ipset list -t"
    if family:
        cmd += " -f {0}".format(family)
    out = __salt__["cmd.run"](cmd, python_shell=False)
    return out
